    }

    async function startSession(repick = true) {
      clearInterval(timer);
      if (repick) {
        rounds = pickUniqueNames(pool, GAME_SIZE);
        await Promise.all(rounds.map((item) => preloadImage(item.image)));
      }
      round = 0;
      totalScore = 0;
      streak = 0;
      results = [];
      renderRound();
    }

    function renderRoundStrip() {
      $('roundStrip').innerHTML = Array.from({ length: GAME_SIZE }, (_, index) => {
        let state = '';
        if (index === round && !answered) state = 'current';
        if (index < results.length) state = results[index].correct ? 'success' : 'failed';
        return `<div class="round-node ${state}"><span>第 ${index + 1} 关</span></div>`;
      }).join('');
    }

    function renderRound() {
      const question = rounds[round];
      attempt = 0;
      currentScore = 1000;
      seconds = ROUND_TIME;
      hintUsed = false;
      answered = false;

      $('stage').classList.remove('success');
      $('timerCard').classList.remove('alert');
      root.style.setProperty('--reveal', REVEAL[0] + 'px');
      setFogPoint(pickFogPoint());
      applyVisual($('backdrop'), question);
      applyVisual($('portrait'), question);

      $('progress').textContent = `${round + 1} / ${GAME_SIZE}`;
      $('score').textContent = '1,000';
      $('streak').textContent = streak;
      $('timer').textContent = ROUND_TIME + 's';
      $('visible').textContent = VISIBLE[0];
      $('attemptLabel').textContent = '第 1 次猜测';
      $('visionState').textContent = '离散侦察点';
      $('positionTip').textContent = '侦察位置已锁定';
      $('footTip').textContent = '猜错一次，扩大视野并切换到另一处侦察点';
      $('hint').innerHTML = '<b>先知提示：</b>暂未使用真视。越早答对，分数越高。';
      $('hintBtn').disabled = false;
      $('skipBtn').disabled = false;

      renderDots();
      renderOptions(question);
      renderRoundStrip();
      clearInterval(timer);
      timer = setInterval(tick, 1000);
    }

    function renderDots() {
      $('dots').innerHTML = Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, index) => `<i class="${index < attempt ? 'used' : ''}"></i>`).join('');
    }

    function renderOptions(question) {
      const decoys = pickUniqueNames(pool.filter((item) => item.id !== question.id), 5, question.name);
      const options = shuffle([question, ...decoys]);
      $('options').innerHTML = options.map((item, index) => `
        <button class="option" data-id="${item.id}">
          <span>${item.name}</span><kbd>${index + 1}</kbd>
        </button>
      `).join('');
      $('options').querySelectorAll('.option').forEach((button) => {
        button.addEventListener('click', () => guess(button, button.dataset.id));
      });
    }

    function updateScore() {
      $('score').textContent = currentScore.toLocaleString();
    }

    function tick() {
      if (answered) return;
      seconds--;
      currentScore = Math.max(100, currentScore - 3);
      $('timer').textContent = seconds + 's';
      updateScore();
      if (seconds <= 10) $('timerCard').classList.add('alert');
      if (seconds <= 0) finish(false, true);
    }
